results.title: Apple Launches Study on Health AI
results.description: Robert M. Wachter, MD, professor and chair of the Department of Medicine at the University of California, San Francisco, highlighted the importance of connecting patient-facing AI tools with clinically reliable information. He noted that patients and healthcare professionals are increasingly using AI, although the technologies available to each group are often developed and evaluated separately. The study will examine whether making reliable medical information more accessible helps individuals arrive at appointments better prepared. However, improved patient outcomes have not yet been demonstrated by the new research initiative.
